_note: Hand-curated from slaythespire2.gg / community guides (2026-06). Keys = character.archetypeId, matching ArchetypeDefinitions. Strings are LLM context (English); the model outputs in the game's language. Refresh per patch; regent/necrobinder marked low-confidence.

ironclad.strength.name: Strength
ironclad.strength.win: Stack Strength, then multiply it across multi-hit attacks to snowball single-target and AoE damage.
ironclad.strength.priorities: Strength generators and multi-hit attacks; Strength retention; ways to apply Vulnerable. Avoid one-shot Strength that wears off.

ironclad.exhaust.name: Exhaust
ironclad.exhaust.win: Turn exhausting cards into value engines and a thin, powerful deck; payoff cards reward each exhaust.
ironclad.exhaust.priorities: Exhaust payoffs and reliable card draw; fuel to exhaust; don't dilute with dead cards.

ironclad.block.name: Block / Barricade
ironclad.block.win: Retain block across turns (Barricade-style) and convert accumulated block into damage; outlast everything.
ironclad.block.priorities: Block retention, Dexterity, and block-to-damage payoffs; enough offense to close.

ironclad.self_damage.name: Self-Damage / Corruption
ironclad.self_damage.win: Pay HP / cheapen skills to power an explosive, low-cost engine; lifesteal or block keeps you alive.
ironclad.self_damage.priorities: Cost reducers, HP sustain, and big payoffs; pair with Exhaust/Strength. Watch your HP buffer.

silent.poison.name: Poison
silent.poison.win: Apply poison with cheap skills, then multiply it (Catalyst-style) so stacks kill bosses over a few turns.
silent.poison.priorities: Cheap poison applicators and poison multipliers; a little Weak/block to survive the ramp; relics that boost or spread poison.

silent.shiv.name: Shiv
silent.shiv.win: Generate many Shivs per turn and trigger 'when you play an attack / 0-cost' payoffs for explosive value.
silent.shiv.priorities: Shiv generators, Shiv/attack payoffs (Dexterity, extra-attack triggers), and draw/cycle to keep the engine fed.

silent.discard.name: Discard / Sly
silent.discard.win: Cycle a thin deck fast; discard triggers Sly cards for free and fuels discard payoffs.
silent.discard.priorities: Discard enablers + draw; Sly/discard payoffs; keep the deck thin so cycling stays reliable.

silent.dexterity.name: Dexterity / Block
silent.dexterity.win: Scale Dexterity so cheap skills give large block; tank hits and chip the enemy down.
silent.dexterity.priorities: Dexterity sources and cheap block/skills; some scaling damage to avoid stalling.

defect.lightning.name: Lightning Orbs
defect.lightning.win: Channel Lightning and pump Focus so passive/evoke lightning clears rooms and pressures bosses.
defect.lightning.priorities: Lightning channelers, Focus, and orb slots/evoke payoffs; block to survive the setup turns.

defect.frost.name: Frost / Focus
defect.frost.win: Stack Frost block + Focus to become unkillable, then close with scaling damage.
defect.frost.priorities: Frost channelers, Focus, orb slots; a reliable damage finisher so you don't stall.

defect.dark.name: Dark Orbs
defect.dark.win: Grow Dark orbs each turn and evoke for one huge hit; Focus accelerates the ramp.
defect.dark.priorities: Dark channelers, Focus, evoke and orb-slot support; defense to survive the ramp.

defect.all_orbs.name: All Orbs / Focus
defect.all_orbs.win: Generic Focus + orb-slot shell that flexes into whatever orbs the run offers.
defect.all_orbs.priorities: Focus, orb slots, channel/evoke flexibility; take the best orb payoffs offered.

defect.zero_cost.name: 0-Cost
defect.zero_cost.win: Chain 0-cost cards with draw and per-card-play payoffs for big free turns.
defect.zero_cost.priorities: 0-cost cards, heavy draw, and 'when you play a card' payoffs; keep deck thin.

regent.stellar.name: Stellar / Stars
regent.stellar.win: Build up Stars/Stellar resources and spend them on scaling payoffs.
regent.stellar.priorities: Stellar/star generators and payoffs, draw to find them, and defense while ramping.
regent.stellar.confidence: low — Regent is newer; validate against current patch

regent.authority.name: Authority / Forge
regent.authority.win: Accumulate Authority/Forge buffs into a scaling damage or value engine.
regent.authority.priorities: Authority/Forge sources and scaling payoffs; survive the setup.
regent.authority.confidence: low — Regent is newer; validate against current patch

regent.minion.name: Minion / Summoner
regent.minion.win: Field minions that deal damage / block for you and scale with summon payoffs.
regent.minion.priorities: Reliable summons, minion buffs/payoffs, and protection to keep them alive.
regent.minion.confidence: low — Regent is newer; validate against current patch

regent.cosmic.name: Cosmic Damage
regent.cosmic.win: Leverage Cosmic/AoE payoffs to clear multi-enemy rooms and burst bosses.
regent.cosmic.priorities: Cosmic/AoE sources and scaling; defense for slower fights.
regent.cosmic.confidence: low — Regent is newer; validate against current patch

necrobinder.doom.name: Doom / Debuff
necrobinder.doom.win: Stack debuffs/Doom on enemies so they collapse under accumulated pressure.
necrobinder.doom.priorities: Doom/debuff appliers and scaling payoffs; block to outlast the ramp.
necrobinder.doom.confidence: low — Necrobinder is newer; validate against current patch

necrobinder.soul.name: Soul / Exhaust Cycling
necrobinder.soul.win: Spend/recycle Souls via exhaust loops to fuel a repeatable engine.
necrobinder.soul.priorities: Soul generators, exhaust synergy, and draw; payoffs that reward cycling.

necrobinder.death.priorities: Death/exhaust payoffs and AoE; sustain to survive the build-up.
